definitions.explanation: Attached to the た-form, presents a supposed situation as the condition for the main clause.
Marks an event expected to happen; the main clause takes place once it is completed.
With a past main clause, introduces an action after which the speaker discovered something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っ→降る：00839_furu⟧たら、⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧です。
examples.english: If it rains, it'll be called off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たっ→当たる：01860_ataru⟧たら、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧？
examples.english: What would you like to do if you won the lottery?

examples.japanese: ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧だったら、⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辞|や}めて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If I were you, I think I'd have quit a company like that right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}い→着く：00680_tsuku⟧たら⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please call me when you get to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わったら⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go for a drink once work is over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧たら、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: When the summer holidays come, we're planning to visit my grandparents in the countryside as a family.
When I opened the window, it was snowing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}っ→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧たら、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I got home, nobody was there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧みたら、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: When I called an old friend for the first time in ages, I was surprised to hear she was getting married next month.

notes:
FORMS:
- Verb: た-form + ら (⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧ → ⟦{行|い}っ→行く：00119_iku⟧たら, ⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧たら)
- I-adjective: ⟦{安|やす}かった→安い：00464_yasui⟧ → ⟦{安|やす}かっ→安い：00464_yasui⟧たら
- Noun / na-adjective: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だったら, ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だったら
- Negative: ⟦{行|い}かなかっ→行く：00119_iku⟧たら

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜たら⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧(です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧): why don't you ~ — ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{休|やす}んだら→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧？
- 〜たら⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: what should I ~, it would be good to ~ — どうしたら⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？
- 〜たらよかった: I wish I had ~ — ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{来|き}たらよかった

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ば: the general conditional; more abstract, and after an action it does not take a request
- ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: an automatic or habitual result; no requests, invitations or wishes after it
- なら: "if that is so", responding to what was just said; the order of events can be reversed

たら is the most conversational of the four and the most versatile: it freely takes a request, an invitation or a past-tense discovery in the main clause.
